answer.text: Right, but not obligation, to enter an IRS
Outright ownership of a floating-rate bond

explanation.text: **The Logic:** Swaption = option on a swap. Payer swaption = right to pay fixed in an IRS; Receiver = right to receive fixed. Option premium paid upfront. **The Trap:** 'Obligation to enter' confuses swaption with an outright forward swap. **Cross-Exam Context:** IV Ch 5 covers swaptions; XXI-B applies in portfolio context. **Manager's Pro-Tip:** Swaptions are used by corporates to hedge anticipated funding-cost volatility — a PMS client with loan liabilities can be steered to them.
